description: This file defines the ModifyAttributesResponse class, which represents the response to a ModifyAttributes command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing responses with different HTTP status codes, parsing JSON representations, and accessing response data such as the thing ID and created attributes.

classes.name: ModifyAttributesResponse
classes.description: Immutable response class for the ModifyAttributes command, providing factory methods, JSON parsing, and response data access.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Factory method for creating a response with HTTP 201 Created status, given ThingId, Attributes, and Headers.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Factory method for creating a response with HTTP 204 No Content status, given ThingId and Headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses the response from a JSON string or object, given the headers.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with the response.

methods.name: getAttributesCreated
methods.description: Returns the Attributes object representing the created attributes.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the attributes as a JsonValue according to the schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource ('/attributes').

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the response data to a JSON object builder, considering the schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response with the given DittoHeaders, maintaining the correct status.

methods.description: Checks if this object can equal another (used for equality comparisons).
